mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_interaction ( owner_key, interaction_type, interaction_id, session_id, turn_id, reply_id, tool_call_id, status, request_json, response_json, expires_at, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{ownerKey}, 'ASK_USER', #{interactionId}, #{sessionId}, #{turnId}, #{replyId}, #{toolCallId}, 'PENDING', #{requestJson}, #{responseJson}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ha_interaction WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND interaction_type = 'ASK_USER' AND interaction_id = #{interactionId}

SELECT * FROM ha_interaction WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND session_id = #{sessionId} AND turn_id = #{turnId} AND interaction_type = 'ASK_USER' AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at, interaction_id
mapper.update: UPDATE ha_interaction SET status = #{status}, response_json = #{responseJson}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE owner_key = #{ownerKey} AND interaction_type = 'ASK_USER' AND interaction_id = #{interactionId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND version = #{version}
